title: Arcane Index Reference: Progression
summary: Let discovery states and relations guide Arcana progression instead of blind crafting.

blocks.title: Early Use
blocks.body: Use Index for overview pages and starter records while the player is still learning Aether Signal and basic routes.

blocks.title: Middle Use
blocks.body: Use relations to connect RelicTech, RitualCore, SpellCore, CurseCore, and Grimoire context before the route gets expensive.

blocks.title: Late Use
blocks.body: Use warning and forbidden records to decide whether a powerful action is ready or just available.

blocks.title: Upgrade Check
blocks.body: Do not raise the risk until the current upgrade tier works without emergency improvising.
